description: Client-side script for the 'Bank Reconciliation Tool' form in ERPNext, handling setup, refresh, data fetching, rendering, and user interactions related to bank reconciliation.

classes.name: NumberCardManager
classes.description: Manages display of numerical cards in the reconciliation tool.

classes.name: DataTableManager
classes.description: Handles the data table displaying bank transactions and reconciliation data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, including query filters for bank account selection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, loads necessary scripts, and triggers reconciliation tool creation.

methods.name: after_save
methods.description: Triggers reconciliation tool update after saving the form.

methods.name: bank_account
methods.description: Fetches account currency based on selected bank account and triggers balance updates.

methods.name: bank_statement_from_date
methods.description: Triggers update of account opening balance based on statement date.

methods.name: make_reconciliation_tool
methods.description: Builds and displays the reconciliation tool UI components.

methods.name: get_account_opening_balance
methods.description: Fetches the opening balance for the selected bank account.

methods.name: get_cleared_balance
methods.description: Fetches the cleared balance up to the statement date.

methods.name: render_chart
methods.description: Renders balance charts in the reconciliation tool.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the data table with bank transactions.
